fields.name: dialogue record
fields.note: read_text: handle +44; sub_3A5980 reads the line (+24) of it through +28 + 4 * line (itfMesMngGetDialogueLine's layout)

fields.name: tag flags
fields.note: read_text: sub_3A5980 stores frFontTestTagFlags(3) there after the layout

fields.name: style
fields.note: read_text: itfMesMngTextCopyNodeStyle copies the style glyph's +0x15 here; sub_3A5980 passes it to the layout (sub_3B2940 arg 2)

fields.name: colour set
fields.note: read_text: itfMesMngTextCopyNodeStyle copies the style glyph's +0x14; layout arg 3

fields.name: mode
fields.note: read_text: itfMesMngTextCopyNodeStyle copies the style glyph's +0x16; layout arg 4

fields.name: alpha (255)
fields.note: read_text: itfMesMngInitTextRecord sets 255; itfMesMngTextCopyNodeStyle stores node alpha >> 1; layout arg 5

fields.name: last line index
fields.note: read_text: sub_3A5980 stores itfMesMngTextGetLineIndex(last node, first node)

fields.name: line
fields.note: read_text: sub_3A5980 indexes the dialogue record's lines with it (range-checked against its +24 count)

fields.name: line step
fields.note: read_text: itfMesMngTextGetLineIndex divides ((node.y - first.y) >> 3) by the first node's +18

fields.name: style glyph
fields.note: read_text: a FrFontGlyphNode; itfMesMngTextCopyNodeStyle reads its +0x14 / +0x15 / +0x16 (colour set, style, mode)

fields.name: scale (100 -> 0 while opening)
fields.note: read_text: itfPnlAnimOpenType10 stores 100 - 100 * frame / 6, itfPnlAnimOpenType11 100 - 100 * frame / 4; both 0 once open
